about.statement: You run the business. We run the marketing.

steps.title: Discover
steps.description: We learn about your business. Your customers, competitors, vendors, workflows, markets, pricing, margins, team, goals, sales process.

steps.title: Strategize
steps.description: We build a plan for your business. Your positioning, messaging, offers, channels, content, budget, calendar, priorities, targets.

steps.title: Execute
steps.description: We do the work while you run the business. Content, creative, campaigns, emails, pages, posts, videos, graphics.

steps.title: Optimize
steps.description: We watch what's working and adjust. Your leads, traffic, engagement, opens, clicks, followers, reviews, conversions, spend, results.

values.heading: How we operate
values.description: Small teams win on focus. So do we.

image.alt: Illustration of four people with speech bubbles and an upward arrow

items.title: Straight talk
items.description: You receive clear answers and honest reporting. We tell you what is working and what is not. If something is not worth the investment, we will say so.

items.title: Embedded
items.description: We operate as an extension of your team. We join your calls, learn what matters to your business, and take responsibility for the work. When your priorities change, our plan changes with them.

items.title: Built for small teams
items.description: We understand that your time and budget are limited, and we plan accordingly. We keep the scope focused so your budget goes where it counts. If something is not paying off, we will recommend cutting it.

items.question: Who is PrimeDesk for?
items.answer: Owner-led businesses that are great at what they do and too busy to market it. You do not have a marketing team in-house, and you want one.

items.question: Where are you based?
items.answer: We are based in the United States. We work with clients remotely and meet in person where it makes sense.

items.question: Can I hire you for one service?
items.answer: Yes. Choose the services you need. Many clients start with one and add more as the results come in.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: It depends on the services you choose. Most clients select a bundle of services and pay one flat monthly fee. We start with a free strategy session, and then we send a clear proposal with no surprises.

items.question: Do you charge for advice and quick questions?
items.answer: No. If you have a question about your marketing or a decision you are weighing, ask us. We do not bill for one-off advice or quick questions, and we do not count minutes. We want you to feel comfortable reaching out.

items.question: Can I change my services later?
items.answer: Yes. Your needs will change as your business grows, and your services can change with them. Tell us what you want to add or drop, and we will adjust the plan. We confirm any change to your scope with you before it takes effect.

items.question: How much of my time do you need?
items.answer: The first few weeks need the most from you. We learn your business, your customers, and your goals. After that, you join a regular check-in call and give feedback on our ideas and creative. We handle the thinking and the heavy lifting.

items.question: Who does the work?
items.answer: Our team does. We handle strategy, content, design, websites, and ads, and we assign you a point of contact.

items.question: Do you shoot photo or video on site?
items.answer: Yes. We work with trusted local photographers and videographers who shoot at your location and bill you directly. We plan the shoot with them and put the content to work in your marketing.

items.question: What do you report on?
items.answer: The results that matter to your business: leads, website traffic, social engagement, email opens and clicks, followers, and reviews. Every month, we explain what the numbers mean and what we recommend next.

items.question: Who owns my accounts, site, and content?
items.answer: You do. Your accounts, website, and content belong to you. We work inside them with your permission, and you keep full access at all times. If we ever part ways, everything stays with you.
